$comment: Bridge events of 1378 to 1444 for the east: North and East, the Ottomans and the Balkans, the steppe and Iran, the Mamluks and the Horn of Africa (plan-1378 §5; milestone 10 step 6; EVT-090 to EVT-094, D-EVT-21). Generated by tools/domain-data/build_bridge_east.py; edit that script, not this file. History is a reference: every event is conditional, most are approximate, none is forced by its date. Realms are tree ids (events-places.json aliases), places are 1444 province ids. `redated` lists the campaign events copied here with an earlier `earliest` (they waited only for 1444); a bridge event replaces the campaign event of the same id.

history.disputes: The diets begin in 1419; the 1435 Treaty of Walk is the usual founding date.
Thessaloniki also surrendered to Murad I in 1387 and was handed back after Ankara; one firing stands for either fall.
Founded 1438 by some accounts, 1445 by others.
1441 is common; some date Hacı Giray's independent rule to 1449.
Sa'ad ad-Din's death is dated c.1403, 1410 or 1415.
The campaign against Egypt is known mainly from Ethiopian tradition.

battle_of_mohacs.name: Battle of Mohács and the partition of Hungary

ottoman_conquest_of_mamluks.name: Ottoman conquest of the Mamluk Sultanate

conquest_of_kazan.name: Muscovite conquest of Kazan and Astrakhan

fall_of_constantinople.why: Bayezid blockaded the city from 1394; the trigger already needs a war, the walls held and the tech.

battle_of_mohacs.why: Needs the Ottomans on Hungary's border at war with it; Nikopolis covers the 1390s.

union_of_lublin.why: Needs the Polish-Lithuanian personal union, which Krewo makes.

ottoman_conquest_of_mamluks.why: Needs an Ottoman-Mamluk war over Syria; the frontier meets after Bayezid takes Malatya and Elbistan.

conquest_of_kazan.why: Kazan is a sleeping realm until it is founded (kazan_khanate_founded).

shaybanid_conquest_of_transoxiana.why: Needs the Uzbek khanate on the Timurid border.

localization.event.battle_of_kulikovo.name: Battle of Kulikovo
localization.event.battle_of_kulikovo.desc: Dmitry of Moscow leads the Rus princes across the Don and breaks Mamai's army on Kulikovo Field. The Horde is not overthrown, but Moscow has shown it can beat the Tatars in the open field.
localization.event.battle_of_kulikovo.option.stand_at: Cross the Don and give battle
localization.event.battle_of_kulikovo.option.hold_the: Hold the Oka line and wait
localization.event.tokhtamysh_burns_moscow.name: Tokhtamysh burns Moscow
localization.event.tokhtamysh_burns_moscow.desc: Two years after Kulikovo, Tokhtamysh, now khan of the whole Horde, falls on Moscow while Dmitry is away raising troops. The city is taken by a ruse and burned, and Moscow pays the tribute again.
localization.event.death_of_louis_the_great.name: Death of Louis the Great
localization.event.death_of_louis_the_great.desc: Louis of Hungary and Poland dies without a son. His daughters inherit, Mary in Hungary and, after two years of argument, Jadwiga in Poland. The union of the two crowns ends with him.
localization.event.death_of_louis_the_great.option.se: Crown a daughter of our own
localization.event.jadwiga_crowned.name: Jadwiga crowned King of Poland
localization.event.jadwiga_crowned.desc: The Polish lords take Louis's younger daughter Jadwiga, ten years old, and crown her king in Kraków, so that Poland has its own monarch and a free hand to choose her husband.
localization.event.union_of_krewo.name: Union of Krewo
localization.event.union_of_krewo.desc: Grand Duke Jogaila of Lithuania promises to be baptised with all his people, to marry Jadwiga and to join his lands to the Polish crown. Poland gains a vast eastern partner, and Lithuania an ally against the Teutonic Order.
localization.event.union_of_krewo.option.accept_the_c: Take the Polish crown and the Latin faith
localization.event.union_of_krewo.option.marry_into_m: Marry Dmitry's daughter and take the Orthodox rite
localization.event.union_of_krewo.option.stay_pagan: Keep the old gods and fight on
localization.event.lithuania_baptised.name: Baptism of Lithuania
localization.event.lithuania_baptised.desc: Jogaila, now Władysław II, returns to Vilnius with Polish clergy. The sacred groves are cut, the eternal fire is put out, and the Lithuanians are baptised in crowds. Samogitia holds out until 1413.
localization.event.lithuania_baptised.option.baptise_: Baptise the land, Samogitia in time
localization.event.lithuania_baptised.option.court_on: Convert the court and leave the villages be
localization.event.ostrow_agreement.name: Agreement of Ostrów
localization.event.ostrow_agreement.desc: After a war between the cousins, Jogaila recognises Vytautas as Grand Duke of Lithuania for life under the Polish crown. Lithuania keeps its own ruler and turns its strength east and south.
localization.event.battle_of_vorskla.name: Battle of the Vorskla
localization.event.battle_of_vorskla.desc: Vytautas backs the fallen Tokhtamysh and leads a great army onto the steppe, meaning to rule the Horde through him. Edigu and Temür Qutlugh destroy it on the Vorskla, and Lithuania's push to the Black Sea stops.
localization.event.battle_of_grunwald.name: Battle of Grunwald
localization.event.battle_of_grunwald.desc: Władysław II and Vytautas lead the armies of Poland and Lithuania against the Teutonic Order. Grand Master Ulrich von Jungingen and most of the Order's knights die on the field, though Marienburg holds.
localization.event.battle_of_grunwald.option.take_the: Take the Prussian towns one by one
localization.event.peace_of_thorn.name: Peace of Thorn
localization.event.peace_of_thorn.desc: The Order keeps Prussia but gives Samogitia to Lithuania for the lives of Władysław and Vytautas and pays a heavy ransom. Its treasury never recovers, and the Prussian towns begin to resent its taxes.
localization.event.peace_of_thorn.option.pay_and_cede: Cede Samogitia and pay the ransom
localization.event.prussian_confederation.name: Prussian Confederation
localization.event.prussian_confederation.desc: The towns and knights of Prussia, led by Danzig, Thorn and Elbing, swear a league against the Order's taxes and arbitrary rule. Fourteen years later they rise and offer the land to the King of Poland.
localization.event.prussian_confederation.option.ban_: Ban the league and seize its leaders
localization.event.livonian_confederation.name: Livonian Confederation
localization.event.livonian_confederation.desc: The Livonian Order, the archbishop of Riga, the bishops of Dorpat and Ösel-Wiek and the towns meet in diets at Walk and bind themselves to keep the peace among themselves and to stand together against outsiders.
localization.event.muscovite_war_of_succession.name: Muscovite War of Succession
localization.event.muscovite_war_of_succession.desc: Vasily II's right to the throne is challenged by his uncle Yuri of Zvenigorod and then by his cousins Vasily Kosoy and Dmitry Shemyaka. For a quarter of a century Moscow is taken and lost, and Vasily is blinded, before he wins.
localization.event.muscovite_war_of_succession.option: Fight for the throne, by seniority of the son
Grant the uncles Galich as their own
localization.event.upper_hungary_giskra.name: Giskra in Upper Hungary
localization.event.upper_hungary_giskra.desc: After King Albert dies, Queen Elizabeth hires the Hussite captain Jan Jiskra to hold the north for her infant son. His Bohemian brotherhoods rule the mining towns of Upper Hungary for twenty years against every king.
localization.event.upper_hungary_giskra.option.let_gi: Let the queen's captain hold the north
localization.event.upper_hungary_giskra.option.buy_hi: Buy Giskra out with the mining towns' silver
localization.event.john_v_restored.name: John V restored
localization.event.john_v_restored.desc: John V and his son Manuel escape from Andronikos IV's prison and go to Murad. With Ottoman troops and Venetian ships they retake Constantinople, and Andronikos flees to Genoese Pera with hostages. The price is more tribute and service to the Sultan.
localization.event.john_v_restored.option.back_john: Back John V for higher tribute
localization.event.ottomans_take_sofia.name: Sofia and Niš fall
localization.event.ottomans_take_sofia.desc: Lala Şahin Pasha takes Sofia, and three years later the Ottomans storm Niš, opening the Morava road into Lazar's Serbia.
localization.event.ottomans_take_sofia.option.raid_an: Raid and return it for tribute
localization.event.battle_of_kosovo.name: Battle of Kosovo
localization.event.battle_of_kosovo.desc: Prince Lazar of Serbia, Vuk Branković and a Bosnian force under Vlatko Vuković meet Murad I on the Field of Blackbirds. Both Lazar and Murad die; the Serbs are spent and become Ottoman vassals.
localization.event.battle_of_kosovo.option.stand_on_t: Stand on the Field of Blackbirds
localization.event.battle_of_kosovo.option.call_on_hu: Fall back and call on Hungary
localization.event.bayezid_accession.name: Bayezid's accession
localization.event.bayezid_accession.desc: Bayezid is proclaimed sultan in the tent on the battlefield and has his brother Yakub strangled at once, so the army has a single master. Fratricide becomes the house's custom.
localization.event.bayezid_accession.option.share_the: Give the brother Anatolia to govern
localization.event.fall_of_tarnovo.name: Fall of Tarnovo
localization.event.fall_of_tarnovo.desc: Bayezid's army takes Tarnovo after a three-month siege. Patriarch Euthymius is exiled, Ivan Shishman is killed two years later, and the Bulgarian tsardom ends.
localization.event.battle_of_nikopolis.name: Battle of Nikopolis
localization.event.battle_of_nikopolis.desc: King Sigismund of Hungary leads a crusade of Hungarians, Burgundian and French knights, Hospitallers and Wallachians down the Danube. The French charge ahead and the army is destroyed before Nikopolis; Vidin falls to Bayezid soon after.
localization.event.blockade_of_constantinople.name: Blockade of Constantinople
localization.event.blockade_of_constantinople.desc: Bayezid builds Anadoluhisarı on the Bosporus and blockades Constantinople for eight years. Manuel II tours the courts of Italy, France and England asking for help; the city starves but holds, saved in the end by Timur.
Hold out and seek help in the West
localization.event.battle_of_ankara.name: Battle of Ankara
localization.event.battle_of_ankara.desc: Timur meets Bayezid near Ankara. The Tatar troops and the Anatolian beyliks' men desert to Timur, Bayezid is captured and dies in captivity, and the beyliks are restored. The Ottoman realm splits among his sons.
localization.event.battle_of_ankara.option.meet_timur: Meet Timur in the open field
localization.event.mehmed_reunites.name: Mehmed I reunites the realm
localization.event.mehmed_reunites.desc: After eleven years of war between Bayezid's sons, Mehmed Çelebi defeats his brother Musa at Çamurlu and rules the whole of the Ottoman realm. The Sheikh Bedreddin rising follows soon after.
localization.event.mehmed_reunites.option.restore_the: Restore the realm and its frontier lords
localization.event.murad_ii_besieges_constantinople.d: Angered that Manuel II backed the pretender Mustafa, the young Murad II lays siege to Constantinople with cannon for the first time. The walls hold, and a revolt by his brother draws him off.
localization.event.murad_ii_besieges_constantinople.o: Lift the siege and crush the rebels
localization.event.fall_of_thessaloniki.name: Fall of Thessaloniki
localization.event.fall_of_thessaloniki.desc: The Despot Andronikos had sold the besieged city to Venice in 1423. Seven years on, Murad II storms it and sacks it, ending Venice's attempt to hold a Greek city against the Sultan.
localization.event.long_campaign.name: The Long Campaign
localization.event.long_campaign.desc: John Hunyadi and King Władysław cross the Balkans in winter, take Niš and Sofia and fight their way to the Zlatitsa pass before the cold turns them back. Murad II, beset in Anatolia, offers a truce.
localization.event.crusade_of_varna.name: Crusade of Varna
localization.event.crusade_of_varna.desc: Urged on by the papal legate, King Władysław breaks the peace of Edirne-Szeged and marches to the Black Sea with Hunyadi. Murad II returns from retirement, and at Varna the crusade is destroyed and the young king killed.
localization.event.crusade_of_varna.option.break_the_: Break the truce and march on Varna
localization.event.tokhtamysh_unites_horde.name: Tokhtamysh unites the Horde
localization.event.tokhtamysh_unites_horde.desc: With Timur's backing, Tokhtamysh takes the White Horde, then Sarai, and after Kulikovo falls on the beaten Mamai. For the first time in twenty years the Golden Horde has one khan from the Dnieper to the Syr Darya.
localization.event.tokhtamysh_unites_horde.option.rid: Ride on Sarai and the west
localization.event.timur_takes_herat.name: Timur takes Herat
localization.event.timur_takes_herat.desc: Timur summons the Kartid malik Ghiyath al-Din to his court and, when he delays, marches on Herat. The city surrenders, its walls are pulled down, and the Kartids become his vassals before being put to death in 1389.
localization.event.timur_three_year_campaign.name: Timur's three-year campaign
localization.event.timur_three_year_campaign.desc: Timur sweeps west through Iran: Tabriz, Georgia and Armenia, then Isfahan, which rises against his tax collectors and is massacred. Shah Shuja's heirs in Fars submit, and the Jalayirids lose Azerbaijan.
localization.event.timur_five_year_campaign.name: Timur's five-year campaign
localization.event.timur_five_year_campaign.desc: Timur returns to Iran, destroys the Muzaffarids, takes Baghdad from Ahmad Jalayir and campaigns through Georgia, the Caucasus and eastern Anatolia.
localization.event.timur_five_year_campaign.option.en: End the Muzaffarids and take Baghdad
localization.event.battle_of_the_terek.name: Battle of the Terek
localization.event.battle_of_the_terek.desc: Tokhtamysh, grown strong, turns on his old patron. Timur crushes him on the Terek, then lays waste to the Horde's cities: New Sarai, Hajji Tarkhan, Tana and Azak burn, and the northern caravan road never recovers.
localization.event.battle_of_the_terek.option.ruin_th: Pursue the khan and burn the cities
localization.event.battle_of_the_terek.option.set_a_n: Set a new khan and go home
localization.event.timur_in_syria.name: Timur in Syria
localization.event.timur_in_syria.desc: The Mamluks had sheltered Ahmad Jalayir and killed Timur's envoys. Timur takes Aleppo, defeats the young Sultan Faraj and burns Damascus, carrying its craftsmen to Samarkand; on his way home he storms Baghdad again.
localization.event.timur_in_syria.option.burn_damascu: Burn Damascus and take its craftsmen
localization.event.timur_in_syria.option.take_homage: Take the Sultan's homage and coin
localization.event.death_of_timur.name: Death of Timur
localization.event.death_of_timur.desc: Timur dies at Otrar on the way to invade Ming China. His chosen heir, his grandson Pir Muhammad, is far away in Kandahar, and his sons and grandsons fight over the empire.
localization.event.death_of_timur.option.heirs_contes: Let the heirs contest the throne
localization.event.death_of_timur.option.march_on_chi: The emirs march on China as he ordered
localization.event.shah_rukh_reunites.name: Shah Rukh rules from Herat
localization.event.shah_rukh_reunites.desc: Timur's youngest son Shah Rukh takes Samarkand from his nephew Khalil Sultan, gives it to his own son Ulugh Beg and rules the empire from Herat as a patron of scholars and builders rather than a conqueror.
localization.event.shah_rukh_reunites.option.rule_fro: Rule from Herat; Ulugh Beg in Samarkand
localization.event.edigu_rules_the_horde.name: Edigu rules the Horde
localization.event.edigu_rules_the_horde.desc: The Manghit emir Edigu, never khan himself, makes and unmakes khans for twenty years. He beats Vytautas on the Vorskla and besieges Moscow in 1408, but the Horde's princes never unite again.
localization.event.edigu_rules_the_horde.option.emir_: Let the emir rule through puppet khans
localization.event.kazan_khanate_founded.name: Khanate of Kazan
localization.event.kazan_khanate_founded.desc: Ulugh Muhammad, driven from Sarai, settles among the Volga Bulgars and makes Kazan the seat of a new khanate that will raid and trade with Muscovy for a century.
localization.event.kazan_khanate_founded.option.hold_: Hold the Volga for the Horde
localization.event.crimean_khanate_founded.name: Khanate of Crimea
localization.event.crimean_khanate_founded.desc: Hacı Giray, raised in Lithuania, is set up as khan in the Crimea with Vytautas's heirs behind him. The Giray dynasty breaks from the Horde and holds the peninsula until the eighteenth century.
localization.event.crimean_khanate_founded.option.bac: Back Hacı Giray in the Crimea
localization.event.crimean_khanate_founded.option.dea: Deal with the Horde's khan instead
localization.event.abul_khayr_uzbeks.name: Abu'l-Khayr's Uzbeks
localization.event.abul_khayr_uzbeks.desc: The young Shibanid Abu'l-Khayr is raised khan by the clans east of the Ural, takes Chimgi-Tura and then Old Urgench and Sighnaq. The Uzbek confederation becomes the power of the steppe north of the Syr Darya.
localization.event.abul_khayr_uzbeks.option.hold_the_: Hold the eastern clans by gifts
localization.event.qara_qoyunlu_rise.name: Rise of the Qara Qoyunlu
localization.event.qara_qoyunlu_rise.desc: Qara Yusuf comes back from Mamluk exile after Timur's death, retakes Tabriz, and in 1410 defeats and kills his old ally Sultan Ahmad Jalayir. The Black Sheep Turkmen rule Azerbaijan and Iraq.
localization.event.barquq_takes_the_throne.name: Barquq takes the throne
localization.event.barquq_takes_the_throne.desc: The Circassian amir Barquq, regent for a child sultan, deposes him and makes himself sultan. A revolt drives him out in 1389, but he returns a year later; from him the Circassian Mamluks rule Egypt and Syria.
localization.event.barquq_takes_the_throne.option.kee: Keep a Qalawunid on the throne
localization.event.barsbay_takes_cyprus.name: Barsbay humbles Cyprus
localization.event.barsbay_takes_cyprus.desc: After Cypriot pirates raid the Egyptian coast, Sultan Barsbay sends fleets to Cyprus. At Khirokitia King Janus is beaten and taken to Cairo; he is ransomed, and Cyprus pays tribute to the Mamluks thereafter.
localization.event.fall_of_ifat.name: Fall of Ifat
localization.event.fall_of_ifat.desc: The Solomonic kings press the rebel Walashma sultans for a generation. King Yeshaq's army pursues Sa'ad ad-Din II to Zeila, where he is killed; his sons flee to Yemen and Ifat ceases to be.
localization.event.adal_rises.name: Adal rises
localization.event.adal_rises.desc: The sons of Sa'ad ad-Din return from Yemen and found a new sultanate on the Harar plateau, out of the Ethiopian kings' reach. Adal takes up Ifat's war and the Muslim tributaries look to it.
localization.event.dawit_and_the_mamluks.name: Dawit I and the Mamluks
localization.event.dawit_and_the_mamluks.desc: King Dawit I campaigns to the edge of Mamluk Upper Egypt to protect the Copts, and the Sultan, wary of the Nile, sends the metropolitan and gifts. A fragment of the True Cross is said to reach Ethiopia in his reign.
localization.event.dawit_and_the_mamluks.option.ride_: Ride north to protect the Copts
localization.event.zara_yaqob_reforms.name: Zara Yaqob's reforms
localization.event.zara_yaqob_reforms.desc: Zara Yaqob, crowned at Aksum, rules the church and the provinces with an iron hand: he settles the Sabbath dispute, punishes heresy, sends envoys to Florence and in 1445 breaks Adal's army at Gomit.
localization.event.zara_yaqob_reforms.option.iron_han: Rule church and court with an iron hand
